Fact: standards_compliance
What to find: Standards, frameworks or regulations the model claims to follow (e.g. ISO/IEC 42001, AI Act Code of Practice).
Card sections that often contain it: Compliance, Responsibility, Safety

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: The card says Llama 4 was developed following the best practices in Meta's Developer Use Guide: AI Protections. It names no external standard, framework or regulation such as ISO/IEC 42001 or the EU AI Act.
quotes: Llama 4 was developed following the best practices outlined in our Developer Use Guide: AI Protections.
